Notes: How much each wave inside a level counts as progress, in levels (0.25 = wave 3 reads the curve half a level further).

Controls how quickly armor loses effectiveness. Reduction = armor / (armor + this). Higher values make each point of armor weaker. At 25: armor 10 = -29%, armor 25 = -50%, armor 50 = -67%. Negative armor increases damage: armor -5 = +17%, armor -25 = +50%, never +100%.
Armor can never reduce an attack below this fraction of its raw damage, so stacking armor can't trivialise every enemy.
Smallest raw damage an enemy attack with a tier above 0 can deal.
